newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Peters absent as NZ First, National resume talks.
newsitem.headline: Peters absent as NZ First, National resume talks.

text.p: New Zealand First's negotiating team was without leader Winston Peters as it resumed coalition talks with the caretaker National Party government on Wednesday.
A New Zealand First spokesman would not give reasons for Peters' absence but said it was "no big deal". He would not say if Peters would attend talks in the afternoon between NZ First and Labour.
Deputy leader Tau Henare was heading the NZ First team, while National's was led by Prime Minister Jim Bolger.
The meeting room where the talks are being held had again been sealed by security staff overnight, after being swept for electronic bugs by the government's security service on Tuesday.
New Zealand First holds the balance of power after this month's election and is negotiating with both National and Labour. It has scheduled talks with both parties on Wednesday and again on Thursday.
